The allotments specified in the Order No. 39 of 2013 made under theProviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1796/17 dated 07thFebruary 2013 is vested absolutely in the State and the possessionof which has been taken for or on behalf of the State under Para (a) ofSection 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of powers vestedin me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a) (inserted by Act, No. 8 of1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms do hereby divest onlythe allotments described in the Schedule I below.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Reference No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/16.Divisional Secretary’s No.: WRSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/04.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.18th July, 2019.
